correctness.rationale: Every fort is classified by hub membership, with minimality tested against all proper fort subsets. The complete three-family list has exactly 2^r+binom(r,2) elements. Fort transversal constraints yield both Z=r and all minimum sets, counted by two disjoint families. Fractional dual bounds 2 and r/2 are met by a rational primal assignment on all three minimal-fort types. Original-definition exhaustive tests validate 87,354 nonempty subsets for r=2..7 and direct zero-forcing behavior at all sizes through r, with 29 exact rational witness checks. The proof, not finite testing, covers all r>=2.

value.rationale: A complete minimal-fort obstruction hypergraph and all integral minimum transversals, together with an exact fractional optimum, are obtained for a canonical planar 2-connected bipartite graph product. The entire infinite family with at least four pages attains a sharp factor-two fractional relaxation gap, providing substantive structural behavior and not a routine numerical substitution.
